annotations.title: Delete a sound or a track

description: Deletes a sound (event) or a track for good, with its versions, like the Delete button on its page: the game stops playing it. Versions that are favorites or also chosen in another sound stay there. While it has a generation queued or running, it is refused: wait for it (job_status). ONLY when the user asked, in this conversation, to delete THIS sound (say its name and game before); never to tidy up on your own, never several at once without listing them and getting a yes. name must be the sound's current name, as a check.

event_id.description: The sound (event) or track to delete, from get_entity, find_sounds or list_folders.

name.description: The sound's current name (from find_sounds or list_folders): if it does not match, nothing is deleted.
